$comment: Canonical inlined form of every PUBLISHED event schema version (packages/events, #532). Updated only by `pnpm --filter @platform/events schemas:lock`, which refuses a backward-incompatible change to a published version. Do not edit by hand.

schema.description: The core stored one attribution touch (first or last) for an order at placement, from cart.metadata.attribution. Emitted once per touch, in the same transaction as order.placed (which stays at v1). `referrer` is an origin, never a full URL.
schema.title: attribution.recorded v1

schema.description: A marketing campaign ended (status -> ended), by schedule or by a staff action. Same shape as campaign.launched so consumers close what they opened.

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: campaign.ended v1

schema.description: A marketing campaign went live (status -> active). Consumers: messaging (window 16) starts flows, marts (window 12), accounting (window 15) opens the spend line.

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: campaign.launched v1

schema.description: An active cart with items saw no activity for the store's abandonment window (cart status -> abandoned). Emitted by the core's abandoned-cart job (window 1); consumed by messaging flows (window 16) and marketing (window 17). `email_hash` is sha256 of the lowercased email, never the email.

oneOf.description: sha256 of the lowercased value; never the raw PII

has_attribution.description: True when cart.metadata.attribution was captured, so the recovery flow can be attributed

total_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: cart.abandoned v1

schema.description: A customer record was created for a store.

email_hash.description: sha256 of the lowercased value; never the raw PII

schema.title: customer.created v1

schema.description: GDPR erasure completed; consumers must delete their copies.
schema.title: customer.erased v1

schema.description: A GDPR export bundle is built and downloadable by the customer (Store API getMyExport, signed in) and by store admins (Admin API getCustomerExport) until expires_at. Ids and timestamps only — never the bundle, never personal data. Consumers: the notifications app tells the customer by email (it reads the address from the customer row at send time; the mail carries no token and no link with credentials).
schema.title: customer.export_ready v1

schema.description: A GDPR data export was requested for one customer of one store (Admin API exportCustomer). The consumer builds the bundle through the core and delivers it; the payload carries ids only, never personal data.
schema.title: customer.export_requested v1

schema.description: A GDPR data export was requested for one customer of one store — by staff (Admin API exportCustomer) or by the customer (Store API requestMyExport). The consumer builds the bundle through the core and delivers it; the payload carries ids only, never personal data. v2 adds requested_by_type; requested_by is the staff_user id or the customer id accordingly.
schema.title: customer.export_requested v2

schema.description: Customer profile, group, consent, or identity link changed.

email_hash.description: sha256 of the lowercased value; never the raw PII

schema.title: customer.updated v1

schema.description: A product feed was (re)generated and is available at `url` for the channel to fetch. Aggregate: product_feed.
schema.title: feed.published v1

schema.description: A shipment was packed and is ready for the carrier.
schema.title: fulfillment.packed v1

schema.description: Picking started for a shipment.
schema.title: fulfillment.picking v1

schema.description: A fulfilment request for a shipment was accepted by a warehouse or 3PL.
schema.title: fulfillment.requested v1

schema.description: Order cancelled before completion. Reverses sales accounting.

discount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

shipping_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

subtotal_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

tax_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

total_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: order.cancelled v1

schema.description: All items delivered or returned; order closed.
schema.title: order.completed v1

schema.description: Payment secured; the order may be fulfilled.
schema.title: order.confirmed v1

schema.description: Checkout completed: the order exists and is awaiting payment capture. Source of truth for sales accounting.

email_hash.description: sha256 of the lowercased value; never the raw PII

discount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

tax_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

total_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

unit_price_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

price_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

discount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

shipping_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

subtotal_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

tax_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

total_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: order.placed v1

schema.description: Status projection changed (status, payment_status, fulfillment_status, edits).
schema.title: order.updated v1

schema.description: PSP authorized the amount.

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: payment.authorized v1

schema.description: Funds captured. Source of truth for cash and PSP-fee accounting.

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

oneOf.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: payment.captured v1

schema.description: Authorization or capture failed.

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: payment.failed v1

schema.description: A product was archived.
schema.title: product.archived v1

schema.description: A product became visible on the storefront.
schema.title: product.published v1

schema.description: A product or its variants changed (any status).
schema.title: product.updated v1

schema.description: A referred customer placed an order with a referral code (referral status -> converted). Rewards are issued by the marketing module afterwards. `code_hash` is sha256 of the code, never the code itself.

code_hash.description: sha256 of the lowercased value; never the raw PII

schema.title: referral.converted v1

schema.description: Refund failed at the PSP; needs manual action.

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: refund.failed v1

schema.description: Refund succeeded at the PSP.

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: refund.issued v1

schema.description: Warehouse received the returned goods.
schema.title: return.received v1

schema.description: Customer or support opened a return.
schema.title: return.requested v1

schema.description: A product review passed moderation (status -> published). Title and body are free text written by a customer and never travel on the bus; consumers read them through the API.
schema.title: review.published v1

schema.description: A shipment was planned for part or all of an order.
schema.title: shipment.created v1

schema.description: Carrier reported delivery.
schema.title: shipment.delivered v1

schema.description: A carrier label was bought for a packed shipment (buyShipmentLabel). Carries the tracking number and the label URL, never an address or a name.
schema.title: shipment.label_created v1

schema.description: Carrier picked up the parcel. Source of truth for shipping cost and COGS timing.

oneOf.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Never a float.

schema.title: shipment.shipped v1

schema.description: Stock changed in a warehouse (one stock_movement row).
schema.title: stock.moved v1

schema.description: Stock of a stock item changed in a warehouse (one stock_movement row of the shared pool). `sku` is the stock item's. `variant_id` and `store_id` are present together, and only when a store caused the movement (a sale, a return, a shipment release); both are absent for a pool movement no store caused (receipt, transfer, cycle count), whose envelope `store_id` is null.
schema.title: stock.moved v2

schema.description: A store's variant was mapped to a stock item (Admin `mapVariantToStockItem`); from now on the variant sells from that item's pool. Ids only. The envelope's `store_id` is the variant's store, `aggregate_type` is `stock_item`, `aggregate_id` the item the variant is mapped to now.
schema.title: stock_item.mapped v1

schema.description: A store (brand) was created.
schema.title: store.created v1

schema.description: Store settings changed.
schema.title: store.updated v1
